The '''father''' of [[Roly Melusar]], head of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Melusar's father was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where he tried to encourage the natives to change the world themselves. He was later killed by the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] for his actions against them.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
